The *Viparītakathā* (Kv 5.3) is a debate situated within the fifth chapter (*vagga*) of the *Kathāvatthu*, the fifth treatise of the Theravāda Abhidhamma Piṭaka [Hazra 1994; SuttaCentral]. In modern bibliographic surveys, the topic of this discourse is described as concerning "perverted perception" or erroneous knowledge (*viparīta ñāṇa*) within the sequence of epistemic inquiries that characterize this chapter [Hazra 1994]. SuttaCentral records one translation of the text into a modern language [SuttaCentral].
